one_month_reasoning: AMD has not confirmed its Q3 date; Nov 3 is an estimate (MarketBeat), and 2 of the last 5 Q3 reports (Oct 26 2021, Oct 29 2024) would have fallen before Oct 30, so I put ~25-30% on the print (and Q4 guide with first Helios revenue) landing inside the window. Also in the window: the Oct 27-28 FOMC after the Sep 16 hike, TSMC Q3 results mid-October, and late-October hyperscaler capex guides (MSFT/META/GOOGL/AMZN), the main read-through for 2027 MI450 demand. Early Helios delivery chatter (first Oracle racks reportedly delivered Sep 9, single source) is mildly supportive. I see no directional edge after an ATH ($639) and pullback, so I use a mixture of lognormals centred ~$606: 72% sigma 0.19 (no earnings in window) and 28% sigma 0.24 (earnings in window), which fattens both tails versus round 1.

fair_value.method: Blend of forward P/E (70%): NTM EPS at Sep-2027 ~$19.65 (0.25 x $15.58 FY27 + 0.75 x ~$21 FY28) x 30x = $590, cut 4.5% for warrant + World Labs dilution = $564; and EV/NTM sales (30%): ~$104.5B x 9.5x + ~$15B net cash over ~1.735B diluted shares = $580. Blended ~$569, ~6% below spot.

methods.inputs: NTM revenue at Sep-2027 ~$104.5B (0.25 x FY27 $88.1B + 0.75 x FY28E ~$110B) x 9.5x = $993B EV + ~$15B net cash = $1,008B / 1.735B diluted shares = $580

bear.story: Helios ramp pace disappoints (cabled design/retimers, HBM4 supply, per SemiAnalysis Jul-2026), MI450 revenue shifts right into 2H27, or hyperscaler capex digests as AI-lab funding tightens and the Fed keeps hiking. FY27 EPS ~$12-13 with ~25x multiple and warrant dilution still occurring.

base.story: Helios ships from late Q3 2026 (early Oracle deliveries), steps up in Q4 and Q1'27; DC roughly doubles, FY27 EPS ~$15.6, NTM ~$20 at horizon; first-GW warrant tranches vest (~4.5% dilution). Multiple de-rates from ~39x FY27 to ~30x NTM, leaving the stock about flat.

bull.story: MI450/MI500 become a true second source at scale (OpenAI 6GW, Meta 6GW, Anthropic converting on schedule), FY27 EPS heads toward the $20 Street high, x86 share gains continue, and a 35-40x premium multiple holds.

thesis_break_reason: ~34% below spot, ~26x FY27 consensus ($15.58) and ~19x FY28E, below the Aug-2026 breakout base. Trading there would most likely mean the guided 2027 DC doubling is broken rather than 72%-vol noise: a real Helios/MI450 ramp slip beyond Q1'27 (not the denied Feb-2026 report), a cut to the OpenAI/Meta/Anthropic first-GW commitments, or a hyperscaler 2027 capex reset.

reasoning: Anchor: $604 close, +281% in a year, ~$1.0T cap, 72% realized vol. Round 2 corrections from the supervisor: (1) dilution is NOT in consensus EPS; no warrant tranches had vested at Jun 27 (10-Q), and Meta holds 160M warrants in addition to OpenAI's 160M, so I apply ~4.5% expected dilution (first-GW tranches + World Labs), about -$25/share on the P/E leg; (2) FY27 consensus is $15.58 (not $15.74) and FY27 revenue consensus is $88.1B, well above my round-1 ~$78B, so the EV/sales leg rises (and I set its multiple at 9.5x so it is consistent with 30x earnings); (3) the three Mercury share citations are one original, and tech-insider.org is dropped as a number source (rack pricing rests on TrendForce); (4) the Feb-2026 Helios slip report is stale and was denied; the remaining ramp-pace risk stays in the bear probability. Follow-up checks: AMD still has not announced a Q3 date; one unverified report says Oracle received its first Helios racks on Sep 9 (labelled judgment, not used in numbers). Net: fair value falls from $582 to $569 (~6% below spot), but the gap is within the error of the shared 30x assumption, and the momentum/bull tail offsets it, so I centre the 12-month median at ~$596 (P>=604 = 0.49, down from 0.495). Distribution: 80% lognormal sigma 0.50 + 20% sigma 0.85 for regime tails. Scenario check: bear $330 (25%), base $600 (50%), bull $950 (25%) -> mean ~$620, consistent with the ladder. 1-month ladder widened for a ~25-30% chance of in-window earnings and the Oct 27-28 FOMC. Research in round 2 was limited to 3 searches.
